title: US blacklists Megaspeed amid Nvidia chip smuggling probe; Alibaba disputes affiliate listing
html: The US Department of Commerce added Singapore-based cloud firm Megaspeed and six of its Southeast Asian affiliates to its trade blacklist on Monday, escalating a federal crackdown on alleged artificial intelligence chip smuggling to China amid intense...
